note: First live sourcing run (2026-08-20 shipped placeholder spine-test rows only). Profile gate is CLEARED, confirmed live by Usama 2026-08-20. Checked 11 agency owners across Clutch, DesignRush, Agency Spotter and web search (PR, brand consulting, B2B social-selling firms); 4 survived qualify. Dropped: a full-stack developer on the team (Point Taken Communications), two solo freelancers with no team (Elliott Stares PR, Unicorn Hunter Recruiting), one agency at 11-50+ employees against the 20 ceiling (Outpost Recruitment), one with a conflicting headcount read across sources (Quimby Digital, 2-10 band vs 19 listed). Shipping 4, not padding to 5.

rows.name: Claire Arnaud-Aubour
rows.evidence: Founder of SpLAshPR Agency, Santa Monica/LA. Full-service PR, events and digital-marketing agency for talent, fashion, food/wine and hospitality brands, running 8+ years. Team page lists 5 named staff besides Claire (digital marketing specialist, SEO/social manager, account manager, business developer, creative lead), none technical. Real client roster and press coverage (Voyage LA, DesignRush profile). Source: splashpragency.com/our-team, designrush.com.

rows.name: Jamie Lamonde
rows.evidence: Founder & CEO of Kindship Group, Madison WI. Strategic marketing, brand and comms consultancy for organic/regenerative food and agriculture brands, founded 2020. Team of 4 (Founder, Creative Director, Strategic Comms Director, Strategic Development Director), no engineer or developer listed. 11 years prior at Organic Valley marketing, founded and sold Edible Madison magazine. Real named clients in food/ag press features. Source: kindshipgroup.com/team, Mountain Laurel Digital feature.

rows.name: Mandy McEwen
rows.evidence: Founder & CEO of Mod Girl Marketing, San Diego CA, founded 2010. Done-for-you B2B LinkedIn prospecting and social-selling consultancy for sales teams (a service, not a self-serve software tool: no automation platform, no SaaS pricing on the site). LinkedIn company page confirms 2-10 employee band, 7 people including a Head of Client Services and a Director of Operations, no engineer or developer role. Source: modgirlmarketing.com/about, LinkedIn company page.

rows.name: Kilee Hughes
rows.evidence: Founder & CEO of Six One Agency, Denver CO, founded 2017. WBENC-certified, Black-owned PR and brand-strategy agency for beauty, wellness and lifestyle brands. LinkedIn company page confirms 7 employees (2-10 band), no engineer or developer on team. Real client roster of majority female/BIPOC-owned beauty and wellness brands. Source: sixoneagency.com/about, LinkedIn company page.
